reviews.text: The whole team at WHVC is so kind, caring, knowledgeable and professional. From the front desk to the techs in the exam room to my exceptional Veterinarian Dr. Kosich.  I am so happy I have them to help with Lilah and her congenital heart condition.  She's still going strong at 15.5.  Thanks team!!!
Dr. O'Malley spent a lot of time with Gabby trying to identify the cause of her coat staining. She even followed up with a friend who is a vet dermatologist. It was a great visit.

Absolutely phenomenal vet office. I have a very anxious husky mix that is a handful at the vet, and they have been nothing but wonderful with her. She’s seen multiple doctors / techs at the office and every single one has been so good with her. You can tell every team member loves their job and truly cares for their patients. This office has gone above and beyond my dog time and time again. I cannot recommend this vet office enough. Thank you Washington Heights for taking such good care of my Sadie over the years. You guys are the best!! :)
The people who work there are very kind and loving towards pets!
Very professional and caring. Very efficient and taking time to explain what's going on with your pet .
Great vet.

Everyone at Washington Heights is kind and caring. They care for my dog like I do, and I never feel rushed by the doctor- there’s always time for my questions and concerns. I’m so thankful for the care we receive- from the front desk, to the techs and doctors! We see Dr. Carter McAdoo regularly and he is so wonderful- very caring and knowledgeable.
Staff and the doctor where kind and professional through out the visit.  I appreciate the detailed explanations we were provided about our dog’s situation, additional testing and treatments!!

So grateful for such a skilled, patient, and flexible staff. My dalmatian struggles with anxiety during even routine physical exams. Washington Heights works with me to make sure it is a positive, safe experience. The team is knowledgeable, informed and it’s just always such a great experience. Thank you team!

Greatest Vet Practice in. Houston. They take care of our Grover like he is their very own. He is a 110 lb Golden who loves to go visit Washington Heights Clinic and, especially, their staff and Vets. I wouldn't want them to change anything.
Dr. Hartis was super smart, kind, thorough, and patient with all of my questions. We are very confident in the care we get with you guys, so thank you!!

I was very nervous to take my cat to the vet due to her anxiety but we had the best experience here! Dr. McAdoo was so patient and gentle with her. The team was very friendly and you can tell how much they care about their animals here!

I switched to Washington Heights from another vet when my dog was 13 years old. I needed a vet that understood my goal of keeping him comfortable without ordering endless tests and procedures.

The initial assessment was done by Dr. Wilkenson. She came up with a great plan, and I credit her with adding two more quality years to his life.  When she left, Dr. Tacum treated Blue. She also did an excellent job and was good at communicating with me.

This is a large clinic, but they still manage to personalize the care.  I'm grateful for the services that were provided.

Everyone is always kind, friendly, and eager to help answer any questions we have about any of our pets’ medical care. We always feel welcome and like our pets are valued and loved by the community at Washington Heights. We love coming here!

I appreciate that the waiting area is welcoming and that my dog can go from the front entrance into a room. Folks at the front desk were helpful. Both Jeremy and Dr. Phi were considerate and informative while providing care for my pup.  They took time to offer explanations and to ask if I had any questions. I truly appreciate the exceptional care. Thank you!

It was such a wonderful experience. My seven year-old male cat had a traumatic experience at a different vet in the past. I haven’t been able to bring him in the vet since without him being aggressive and fearful. This time around the team did so amazing and handled the whole visit with care and compassion.

Dr. McAdoo saved my dog, Cleo’s, life! She was so communicative throughout the entire process/procedure and made sure to answer all our questions. The staff (front desk and techs) were so welcoming and helpful. You can really tell how much they love all their patients. After Cleo’s emergent procedure, the front desk staff made sure to love her up until my husband was able to pick her up.

Wish I could give this 0/5 stars. I was referred to Washington Heights Vet Clinic by my dog's veterinary behaviorist specifically for their care with anxious dogs. After a solid first appointment, the experience went downhill fast. Follow-ups were never scheduled, callbacks were promised and never came, and it took three business days to get a response about an urgent concern. On the day before my dog's heartworm shot, I was asked to switch doctors for an appointment I had booked a month in advance. I went the entire day without a single update and when I called for one, I was told the doctor would go over everything at pickup. When I raised that communication had been poor, the staff member hung up on me mid-sentence. This clinic is not equipped to care for anxious dogs. The staff has horrible bedside manner and poor communication, and I will be exercising my free will to never return.

Dr. Tracy McAdoo is such a fantastic doctor. She listens to your concerns and doesn’t end the visit until she’s sure they’ve been addressed. She gives great recommendations and explains everything very well. We appreciate it! Everyone at Washington Heights Vet is kind, caring, friendly, and helpful. We recommend them strongly to our friends and family!
The best!

Everyone we worked with from setting up the first appointment to actually meeting during our visit was very friendly and loved animals.  It was really heartwarming.  My dogs are being internationally exported, so the attention to detail and willingness to work with my exporter to meet the requirements was impressive and left me with peace of mind.  Every vet on staff being USDA certified is a tremendous plus as well when considering where to take pets that will be exported.  That certification is required for the export documentation.  The facility was well designed, clean, and a bit whimsical, which was fun while waiting.  The space also was set up so while waiting dogs would be separate and not necessarily looking at each other as all the seating is along one side, which means aggressive dogs won’t be looking other pups in the eyes and possibly getting worked up.   The exam rooms were clean and well equipped with modern adjustable tables and scales which works really well for older pets or larger ones that are difficult to lift.  We were also able to fill out prescription as my puppy had moved into the next weight class, which was great as well.  One stop shopping and set up for the next 6-months of heart worm and flea/tick treatments.   Overall a fantastic place to bring your pets!

The staff were welcoming and professional. They went out of their way to help us in our situation and turn a stressful situation into a good experience. They gave our dogs a thorough examination and listened carefully to our questions and concerns. They then explained everything very clearly. When we return to Houston, they will be our vet of choice.
Wait time was minimal, check out very easy. Dr. Tacam was very thorough and detailed with both the exam and communication.

They came highly recommended by a family friend since we moved here 2 years ago. They have been helping (me &) my elderly Vizsla deal with UTIs, gastrointestinal issues, and all those other messy things that come with aging.

We have lived in 2 different states and had 3 different vets and I say hands-down, WHVC is the best. They clearly communicate with me about the status of the my dog, patiently answer my questions, and show genuine interest in the welfare of my pup. Everyone is friendly, professional, knowledgeable and they CARE about your furry family member.

Also, they are up front about their costs. I highly recommend.

The tech and the vet we saw took time to make sure my pet was comfortable and thoroughly answered all of my questions. I had my hands full, so they even came to the room to allow me to pay, and helped me out of their office. They went above and beyond!
Great staff and doctors. They take time to listen and address your concerns.
Fast, easy, friendly! Very knowledgeable.
They were able to get my dog is pretty quickly and Dr. Carter M was very thorough and patient with my dog.

OMG - I’m sitting in the waiting room for the 2nd time this month because the veterinarian incorrectly stated that my dog is “fixed”, for his international travel documents. The techs first question is the relocation company tell me what type of test it is…….. the documents were sent to them. Thought this process we’ve had to redo visits 3 times Ofcourse each costing us. The vet tech today said his blood work will cost between $150-$375 she’s not sure but also he missed a heart worm test on March 38th - yup that’s not a mistype- I asked twice and she said the 38th. Okay people this one is the icing on the cake as I sit here she comes back and tells me the test is $989.00——RUN DONT WALK DONT COME TO THIS PLACE.

I swear this place is ran by clowns they had to come back in 9 minutes later and draw more blood because they forgot to take for the heart worm test…… guess I should have come on MARCH 38th!!!!!! I officially think they should close down.

My little dog was diagnosed with diabetes and a friend recommended this clinic/hospital and I’ve never been happier.  The staff here is very supportive, knowledgeable , and caring, specially Patricia, Dr Tacam , Dr McAdoo. The front desk staff is very. Attentive , friendly and responsive. . My dog is getting the best care he ever had.
I highly recommend this clinic.

Found this clinic from ChatGPT and I’m SO thankful! The whole process from start to finish was easy and a great experience. Bo loved his visit today and loved the entire staff. They were so sweet to him and took excellent care of him. Bo has a new favorite tech and doctor! Very appreciate of Jo and Dr. Pilgram. You can tell that they love what they do. They answered all of our questions, were thorough with his care, exam and treatment plan and upfront on pricing. Bo can’t wait to go back and see them! Thanks so much for taking care of my fur baby!
Very friendly staff, barely any wait time, and handled my kitten with the upmost care. They will stay my forever vet
The vets here are gentle and made this a really good experience for my cat.

Cannot say enough positive things about this practice! Techs are warm, friendly, professional and empathetic. Dr. Garrou is outstanding in every way- she is incredibly knowledgeable and fantastic w my cats and dog! She is so patient and answers all of my questions- truly a 10/10 experience all around! I would not trust my beloved babies with anyone else!!!
Everyone at WHVC loves animals, and works with them so well. I love bringing Chen and Kiki in for visits. Dr. Tracy McAdoo is an exceptionally talented Vet.
They care about the service they provide. Our pets are grateful.
Ease and timeliness of scheduling, thoroughness and professionalism of visit including explanation of every step taken.  Expedited surgery as needed, too.  Couldn’t ask for more.

Dr Tacam is a wonderful veterinarian.My boy  Boston has fear aggression at the vet and you guys always know exactly what to do to help him have a pleasant fear free experience. Dr Tacam is very thorough, kind, and knowledgeable. She answered all of my questions and addressed all of my concerns. This was a very pleasant experience.
Staff was great and were very caring towards our Lollie, our multipoo.
Excellent care provided by Dr Macadoo and the office. She explained my dogs condition and explained in way I understand. I'm fully aware of the treatment plan and what to expect going forward.
Everyone is friendly. Doctor and assistant were patient with getting to know our pet. Explained everything in detail.

My dog Rosie had a physical, blood work, shot, and nails trimmed. The techs were very loving and very concerned about my dog's comfort. The Dr was attentive and thorough but not an alarmist. I appreciate that too. And he was also very loving to my dog. Everyone there clearly loves animals!!

I brought Maverick in for his annual exam and had such a great experience. The staff was warm, patient, and so gentle with him from the moment we walked in. Dr. O'Malley took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and truly made Maverick feel comfortable. You can tell they genuinely love what they do. I always feel confident bringing him here, and today was no exception. Highly recommend this clinic for anyone who wants exceptional, compassionate care for their pets!

Dr. Hartis and the team did great with my very sweet boy even though he was scared. The exam was not rushed and they did an amazing job building trust with my dog and letting him “tell” them what he was and was not comfortable with.

I was truly satisfied with the care provided by the assistants and the doctor for Purrla and Mango's annual checkup. They took notes, examined my two babies properly, checking their eyes, checking their heart rate, and feeling their muscles—everything was perfect.

They have a very friendly staff, always willing to help you solve any situation. I take my three dogs to this clinic and we are really happy with them. Dr. O’Malley and Dr. McAdoo have been very supportive and caring of our furry babies. We’ve seen other doctors too and we always had the solution we needed. We’ll keep working with them.

I took in my German shepherd this week for an upset stomach. After calling back for continuing issues after he has been on their prescribed medication they said I could not speak to a vet for the rest of the day. (They were open for another whole hour) and told me to go to an emergency vet when I tried to clarify the next steps the vet said they would provide. They did not provide any instructions for weaning him off the bland diet despite telling me they would give clear instructions. They said call us so we can tell you what to do. Only to be met with “go somewhere else” very disappointed and will be finding a new vet.

I’ve been bringing my dog Georgie to Washington Heights Vet Clinic for years and have always felt the staff genuinely care about the animals. I’ve especially appreciated my visits with Dr. Tacam, who has been kind and attentive.

That’s why I was so disappointed with a recent experience. On 8/8, during a pre-surgery visit with Dr. Phi, I was told cryotherapy for a small growth under Georgie’s eye would “just make it fall off” with no side effects. Based on that, I chose cryotherapy to avoid any visible mark. After the 8/13 procedure, Dr. Tacam informed me it would likely cause permanent pigmentation loss and possible discoloration — something I was never told beforehand.

I share this not to discredit the care my dog has received here in the past, but because I believe full and accurate disclosure is essential to informed consent. I hope the clinic will take steps to ensure that all clients are given complete information about potential outcomes before making decisions about their pets’ care.
Wonderful place to take my cats! Vets are excellent!
I never once left this place feeling respected or valued.

Clean and cool looking vet office and the doctor and nurses were super helpful and friendly. Glad my kitties have this place to go to! Also, reasonably priced which feels rare these days. Thanks so much!

BEWARE, BEWARE, BEWARE: I called this place to ask for some veterinary help and a simple quote. The meanest and sassiest guy answered the phone and spoke to me in the most condescending tone that it was enough to make me never want to come here. If this is how they treat potential new customers, I can only imagine what current customers go thru. Management needs to have a sit down talk with their personnel about talking to customers in general because that type of customer service will not attract any customers and they are the face and voice of your business. I get it, veterinary offices can be stressful, but as an employee you need to know how to handle that type of stress and talk to customers. Go to therapy if you need it.
We have taken our cat here since he was a kitten, and they love him so much. We board him there whenever we travel, and we call it "cat party" because he has so much fun.🐈‍⬛🐱🐈 …
Everyone is friendly and knowledgable and clearly love pets!
I love it here! They are patient and always comfort my shy dog!
Chewy and I were seen almost immediately by Phi and her assistants - very friendly and professional clinic
Excellent vets, no matter who you see. I am partial to Dr. McAdoo and now her son who has joined the practice. But everyone is excellent including the staff.

I've appreciated the experience I've had at WHVC thus far. From in-take to pick-up, and beyond - the staff and vets are very friendly and very sweet/ concerned for my furbaby, and their communication is above par. It's so much more evident compared to my previous vet practice. I can feel how much they care, their patient care/ beside manner is great. My vet, Dr. Garrou was very patient with me in answering all of my questions and was able to explain complicated things in an easy to understand manner. Her empathy really shines through as she discusses next steps and potential concerns.
Everyone in the clinic is amazing. The doctors are caring and knowledgeable. The vet assistants are the best, always extra caring and kind. Everyone is kind, especially in the hardest moments.
Dr. Traci  is always wonderful and I leave with the confidence that my dog got the absolute best care.
Awesome service everytime

I wrote a review about my personal experience with scheduling an appointment. I made the mistake and arrived on the wrong day. That was my fault. It took a response from the manager to get me to see my error. However, while I was waiting to be seen, I couldn't help but hear the staff openly talking about a customer who arrived late for their appointment. I understand that a healthcare office with medical staff have to keep a schedule, but to openly talk about the customer, after they've left, and around other prospective customers/pet parents, is something I'd rather not associate with. I hope Skyler's owner doesn't have to deal with that sort of disrespect in-person.
Our visit was extremely thorough while remaining timely, I left feeling great about the care my cat received and will definitely make this place our new home base in terms of vet care :)
Wonderful staff and doctors.  Willing to help, hear you out and explain the cons and pros of the proposed medical process.
Informative staff that took the time to go over my dog’s medical needs and were super friendly! Love the waiting room and the chalkboard sign welcoming the day’s appointments.

I did not intend to write a review as I have enjoyed the staff at this place and the vet techs are all very nice, however I need to warn future patients that may come.

My puppy joined this Vet as a puppy and went through a round of medicine to resolve her UTI. Then my puppy gets better and gets another UTI, so we do another round of medicine. This proceeds to happen no joke around 8 times over the span of her short lived 1 year of life. Where my puppy gets a reaccuring UTI and then the Vets recommend to do another round of medicine. I am trusting the vets at this point, but keep in mind after these 8+ rounds of medicine and check ups and scans, I have spent
around $5,000 or even more I wouldn’t be surprised.

Turns out her Kidney was now damaged and they for some reason did not think take this kidney thing as an issue so we did not know her kidney was failing until I myself took her to the vet for my own suspicions. I literally used google and ChatGPT to better diagnosis my dog than $5,000 worth of vet visits at this clinic.

After they scan her kidney they basically tell me it’s out of their hands and I need to go to a specialist where they can charge me around $10,000k to resolve this.

My dog unfortunately was put down to sleep due to the fact that this whole process was delayed and by the time she was successfully diagnosed, she already had permanent damage.

Long story short, it feels like they just wanted to keep pumping my dog full of drugs to take the easy way out, keep me coming in and spending thousands of dollars. And then going in circles and circles when my dog kept getting her UTIs. They should have been smarter than me using Google to have diagnosed this Kidney issue. She could have potentially been saved if they could think to check this.

I have another dog and I will NOT be taking her here and will be trying another vet.

$5000+ plus later my dog is gone and they basically tell me they can’t do anything else and whoopsie daisy we found it too late.

We came to this vet after a horrible experience at another vet. My dog has a lot of anxiety and can be a handful during examinations. Dr Tyler Kosich has been nothing short of amazing. We are very pleased with the quality of care and how he is willing to work with us/our dog to get him the care that he needs. THANK YOU!!

They’re fine. Availability is pretty good and we like our current doctor (previous one was a bit rude but did an ok job). They have a quick turnaround for medicine refills which is nice. I don’t trust that they have my best financial interest at heart as it seems like there’s always some additional thing for a couple hundred bucks which I understand for a business but I would like it more if I didn’t need to have my guard up when it comes to my vet.

The staff and doctors at Washington Heights have consistently provided prompt, competent, and compassionate care to our dogs over the six years we've been coming here, and are great about educating pet owners on what's going on with their animals. They have an easy-to-navigate system for general maintenance appointments, and they offer very reasonable advice and well-explained care plans for specific medical issues. 10/10, can't recommend these folks enough.

Washington Heights has been my Vet for several years.  I have been extremely happy with their service and the loving care to my pets.  I had to board my 16 year old cat over the Thanksgiving holiday.  She was in medical boarding due to her age and a few minor health issues.  I knew that Gusta would get the best of care.
She came home just fine AND
she now sits in my lap!  I’m so happy!
THANK YOU WASHINGTON HEIGHTS VET
CLINIC💕

I came to Washington Heights after a bad experience at North Durham. I tried to go the cheap route but ended up spending more there in both money and worse time due to questionable business practices. So glad I moved to this vet. Their staff is amazing. My dog is reactive when scared and he loved our new vet. He is scared of men but loved his new vet. Great staff and great practice!
Every appointment is professional, yet personal and friendly towards my pets and myself.  I love the level of care and the feeling of family at this clinic.

I’ve been coming here for years and I’ve always been happy with their service. I no longer live close but a 30 minute drive is worth it to me. I originally would see Dr. Case and only her because she made me and my babies comfortable. When she’s wasn’t available we started to see Dr. Kosich. He’s also a great doctor so they are my usual go to’s for our appointments. As for last minute semi emergency appointment I’ve been happy with those doctors as well. I’ve been to other clinics where I feel the Dr. is pushing for extras and recommending more than what is actually needed. But I don’t get that feeling from here. With that said, it’s still not always the cheapest. But I believe you usually get what you pay for. So even though I’ve shopped for other clinics closer to me I just can’t bring myself to leave WHVC.

They are the best. I took my pup to another vet before taking them here & thru overlooked my pups tumor and cancer, a month went by and she got very I'll so I brought her here and they diagnosed her & were very patient and kind when having the "put her to sleep" convo. I just recently took my other pup and they found an issue that would've been overlooked at other places. They are truly the best & the techs are so sweet too. If you love your babies, bring them here.

All the veterinarians I have seen here have provided wonderful care in addition to the exceptional evidence based knowledge, and professionalism. I have brought multiple dogs here throughout the years, hence the different Vets, but I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend any one of them.
We love the vets and staff at Washington Heights Vet Clinic. They always provide compassionate and quality care. Highly recommend.
Great Service and Great people to work with... my Cookie loves ❤️ it there.
They treated our puppy so well and explained everything they were doing. Will be coming here for all future dog visits

Best Vet in Houston! They're always so helpful, accomodating and caring for the owner and my pet! I've have to go through the process of getting the certificate for my cat for international travel and they've been super helpful and responsive every time. Hope the travel goes smooth! Recommend them to everyone :)

Dr. Tacam and our vet tech Anita were absolute rockstars! They were so patient with my very anxious dog and tried everything to get her to feel comfortable while performing the tests she needed. I am so grateful to both of them for working with us and making us feel at ease. I was recommended WHVC by a coworker and will keep recommending it to others - thanks everyone!
Caregivers have always been very attentive, precise in communication, and don't make us feel rushed.
Great vets, kind people at the desk, have been going to WHVC since they opened

I moved my two dogs Molly and Macy in February 2022 due to a tragic event with the vet that I had had for the last four years.   Washington Heights vet assigned my girls to Dr. Wilkinson and it has been top notch first class service.  Dr. Case operated on one of my girls and found a malignant tumor and removed it and Molly was actually in for a different surgery but because Dr. Case did such a thorough exam she called me during Molly‘s surgery to ask me if she could remove this tumor that she was suspicious about that ended up being malignant.  I cannot say enough good things I cannot say enough professional things.  As human healthcare provider they are top-notch as animal care providers.  Their staff is over-the-top and so are their doctors.   Thank you so much Washington Heights for taking such good care of my girls.  ❤️
